boundaries.name: The vector store is reached by one contract
boundaries.detail: 1 collection, 9 operations, all in `ai`. No screen, service or other contract reaches it directly.
boundaries.enforcedBy: tools/check-package.py — no non-AI contract writes an AI table

boundaries.name: Writes stay inside the domain
boundaries.detail: AI reads the transactional core and writes only its own stores and caches. `generateVenueLayout` wrote into `seating.import_job` on 17 August and now stops at a draft.

boundaries.name: Conversation logs sit off the transactional primary
boundaries.detail: Prompt and response volume does not compete with a sale. 5 tables on the analytical store.
boundaries.enforcedBy: ADR-0020, checked against the store map

boundaries.name: Every model call leaves an audit record
boundaries.enforcedBy: tools/check-package.py — a model-calling operation with no interaction fails

boundaries.name: Only governed operations outside the domain may write to it
boundaries.detail: 2 operations in other contracts write an `ai.*` table: ['askReportingQuestion', 'saveNaturalLanguageQuery']. Each is a governance record, not a bypass.

note: Derived by closure from the contract, not listed. See handoff/README.md — the hand-maintained version of this drifted four times in one day.
